title: Variance Reduction for Gradients from Diffusion Teachers
abstract: arXiv:2605.21489v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Pretrained diffusion models serve as frozen teachers for pipelines such as text-to-3D, single-step distillation, and data attribution. The teacher gradients these pipelines consume are expectations over noise levels and Gaussian noise, estimated by Monte Carlo (MC). Each MC draw requires expensive upstream work (rendering, simulation, encoding), so estimator variance dominates compute cost. We introduce CARV, a compute-aware variance-accounting framework that casts these gradients as a classical two-stage sampling problem with asymmetric per-level costs. This motivates a hierarchical MC estimator that amortizes each expensive upstream computation by reusing it across cheap diffusion draws, with within-unit variance further reduced by timestep importance sampling (IS) and stratified inverse-CDF sampling. CARV delivers 2 to 3x effective compute multipliers on text-to-3D and data attribution without changing the objective. In text

translated_title: 扩散教师模型梯度的方差削减
translated_abstract: 预训练扩散模型可作为冻结的教师模型，服务于文本到3D生成、单步蒸馏和数据归因等流程。这些流程所消耗的教师梯度是关于噪声水平和高斯噪声的期望，通过蒙特卡洛（MC）方法估计。每次MC采样都需要昂贵的上游计算（如渲染、模拟、编码），因此估计器的方差主导了计算成本。我们提出了CARV，一个计算感知的方差核算框架，它将这些梯度建模为一个具有不对称每层成本的经典两阶段采样问题。这启发了一种分层蒙特卡洛估计器，通过将每次昂贵的上游计算在多个廉价的扩散采样中复用来摊销其成本，并通过时间步重要性采样（IS）和分层逆CDF采样进一步降低单元内方差。CARV在不改变目标函数的情况下，为文本到3D和数据归因任务带来了2至3倍的有效计算乘数。
tldr: 提出CARV框架，将扩散教师梯度估计建模为计算感知的两阶段采样问题，结合分层蒙特卡洛估计、时间步重要性采样与分层逆CDF采样，在不改变目标函数的前提下为文本到3D和数据归因带来2至3倍的有效计算提升。
en_tdlr: CARV, a compute-aware variance-accounting framework that treats diffusion teacher gradient estimation as a two-stage sampling problem, combines hierarchical Monte Carlo, timestep importance sampling, and stratified inverse-CDF sampling to deliver 2-3x effective compute multipliers for text-to-3D and data attribution without changing the objective.
